[DQC.US.0237.10935] The filer has used the StatementOfIncomeLocationBalanceAxis with a value of us-gaap_ResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseMember in the filing. This member is used to identify the location of the line item in the income statement. However, the concept us-gaap_ResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseMember does not appear in the face financial statements.

Rule Element Id:10935
Rule version: 30.0.5 - acrx20260331_10q.htm 173

[DQC.US.0237.10935] The filer has used the StatementOfIncomeLocationBalanceAxis with a value of us-gaap_SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpensesMember in the filing. This member is used to identify the location of the line item in the income statement. However, the concept us-gaap_SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpensesMember does not appear in the face financial statements.

Rule Element Id:10935
Rule version: 30.0.5 - acrx20260331_10q.htm 173

[DQC.US.0238.10937] The filer has used the table text block ScheduleOfSegmentReportingInformationBySegmentTextBlock in the filing, but has not reported any facts with the StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis. A segment member is required to be reported with the StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis even if there is only one reportable segment. (see FASB Taxonomy Implementation guide at https://www.fasb.org/projects/fasb-taxonomies/resources/taxonomy-implementation-guides ) The filer should report facts with the StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis if using the ScheduleOfSegmentReportingInformationBySegmentTextBlock
